summary: On 19 August 2026 the Welsh Government announced that work had begun on Wales's first Climate and Nature Action Plan, treating climate change and nature loss as one connected challenge. The plan was framed around net zero by 2040, ten years earlier than the statutory 2050 target, and substantive nature recovery by 2050. A Climate and Nature Board chaired by Llyr Gruffydd, Cabinet Minister for Rural Resilience and Sustainability, was to be established with external expertise to shape the plan and hold delivery to account. No publication date or legislative route for the 2040 date was given.
title: Welsh Government starts Wales's first Climate and Nature Action Plan, aiming for net zero by 2040 and substantive nature recovery by 2050
